stories.title: The Fallen Tower
stories.text:
Hana had built a tall tower of wooden blocks. Her little cousin Arun ran past and knocked it over with a crash. [hc|Her cheeks felt hot] and her fists were tight. In her hand was [ha|the small blue block with the chipped corner]. Arun whispered, [hb|"Everyone drops things, right?"] and his lip began to shake.
===
Last year, Hana had been building a model bridge for school in the crowded living room. Her friend Dev had picked up [da|the small blue block with the chipped corner] to help.

It had slipped from his hand and the bridge had crashed down. [dc|Hana's cheeks had burned hot] and her fists had tightened. [x1|Dev's face had turned pale.] Grandma had come in and said softly, [db|"Everyone drops things."]

Hana had taken a slow breath and smiled at Dev. He had put [ea|the small blue block with the chipped corner] back in its place, and they had built the bridge again. [x2|It had been the best bridge in the class.]

Hana had learned what Grandma meant. [eb|"Forgive the person, not the mess,"] Grandma had said. [ec|Her cheeks had cooled and her heart had felt light.]
===
Hana took a slow breath. [lb|"Forgive the person, not the mess,"] she said softly, and she smiled at Arun. [lc|Her cheeks cooled and her heart felt light.] She put [la|the small blue block with the chipped corner] on the floor, and together they began the tower again.

stories.title: Standing Beside Sara
stories.text:
At recess, Wei Jie saw two boys laughing at Sara's old, patched school bag. Sara stared at the ground. He pushed [ha|his round glasses with the green strap] up his nose. In his head he could almost hear [hb|"Leave him alone!"] ringing like a bell. [hc|His heart began to thump loudly.]
===
Last year, Wei Jie had sat in the noisy canteen with a bowl of noodles. Two older boys had laughed at [da|his round glasses with the green strap].

[dc|His heart had thumped loudly] and he had wanted to hide. [x1|His noodles had gone cold.] Then a girl named Mei had stood up from the next table. [db|"Leave him alone!"] she had said in a clear, strong voice.

She had stood right beside him until the boys walked away. [x2|The canteen clock had struck one.] Wei Jie had pushed [ea|his round glasses with the green strap] up his nose and smiled at her.

Wei Jie had learned what brave looked like. [eb|"Stand beside someone who needs you,"] Mei had told him. [ec|His heart had felt steady and strong.]
===
Wei Jie took a deep breath. [lb|"Stand beside someone who needs you,"] he told himself. [lc|His heart felt steady and strong.] He pushed [la|his round glasses with the green strap] up his nose, stepped forward and said, "Leave her alone!" Then he stood right beside Sara until the boys walked away.

areas.wr: Good: the glasses are what the boys laughed at, but they do not show the moment Mei spoke.

stories.title: The Thirsty Plant
stories.text:
It was Danish's turn to look after the class plant, but he wanted to play football. The leaves had begun to droop. [ha|A trickle of water from the tap] dripped in the sink. [hb|His tummy felt heavy.] On the window sill sat [hc|a green watering can with a dented spout].
===
Last year, Danish had forgotten to water Grandma's tomato plant for a whole week. When he finally looked, the leaves had drooped like tired hands.

[db|His tummy had felt heavy] with worry. He had grabbed [dc|the green watering can with the dented spout] and run to the tap. [da|A trickle of water from the tap] had been all he could get at first. [x1|The sun had been bright and hot.]

Grandma had said, "Plants cannot ask. We must remember for them." [ea|Danish had poured the water slowly,] a little at a time. [x2|Grandma had given him a tomato] to taste.

By evening, the leaves had lifted again. [eb|His tummy had felt light and glad.] The next morning he had filled [ec|the green watering can with the dented spout] again without being asked.
===
Danish put down his ball. The thirsty leaves had been on his mind all morning, but [lb|his tummy felt light and glad] now that he had a plan. He filled [lc|the green watering can with the dented spout] at the sink. Then he [la|poured the water slowly,] a little at a time. Soon the leaves began to lift.

areas.wr: Workable: a trickle of water could be in any story about water.

areas.wlr: Ideal: pouring slowly is the very habit that fixes the plant, so it shows the change best.

areas.wr: Ideal: a heavy tummy points straight at Danish's worry, the heart of the Problem.

areas.wlr: Workable: feeling light and glad shows the change, but it is the weakest sign of learning.

stories.title: Just One Tiny Bite
stories.text:
At her friend Priya's party, Ling stared at a plate of strange orange fruit. [ha|Her tummy felt wobbly.] She could almost hear [hb|"Just one tiny bite,"] in her head. In her hand was [hc|a small silver spoon].
===
Last year, Ling's grandpa had put a bowl of bumpy green soup in front of her. [da|Her tummy had felt wobbly] and she had pushed the bowl away.

Grandpa had given her [dc|a small silver spoon] and said gently, [db|"Just one tiny bite."] [x1|The kitchen had smelled of ginger.]

Ling had closed her eyes and tasted. The soup had been warm and sweet. [x2|Grandpa's old radio had played soft music] in the kitchen. [ea|Her tummy had stopped feeling wobbly.]

From then on, Ling had tried one tiny bite of everything. [eb|"Just one tiny bite is a brave start,"] she had told herself. She had kept [ec|the small silver spoon] in her bag for new foods.
===
Ling took a deep breath. [lb|"Just one tiny bite is a brave start,"] she whispered to herself. She scooped a little fruit onto [lc|the small silver spoon] and tasted it. [la|Her tummy stopped feeling wobbly.] It was sweet and juicy, and she asked for more.

stories.title: The Paper Plane
stories.text:
Zayd looked at the empty seat beside him. His best friend Jun had moved away last week. A new boy stood by the door, and Zayd could almost hear [ha|"Want to sit with me?"] echo in his head. In his school bag lay [hb|a paper plane with red wings]. [hc|His chest felt heavy and lonely.]
===
On the first day of Primary 1, Zayd had sat alone at the back of the room. [dc|His chest had felt heavy and lonely.]

A boy named Jun had walked over, holding [db|a paper plane with red wings]. [da|"Want to sit with me?"] he had asked with a big smile. [x1|Jun had a gap in his front teeth.]

Zayd had nodded. They had flown [eb|the paper plane with red wings] across the hall at recess. [x2|The bell had rung loudly.]

From that day, they had been best friends. [ea|"A friend is someone who sits with you,"] Zayd had thought. [ec|His chest had felt light and warm.]
===
Zayd stood up and walked to the new boy. [la|"A friend is someone who sits with you,"] he said with a big smile. "Want to sit with me?" He pulled out [lb|the paper plane with red wings] and showed it to him. [lc|His chest felt light and warm.]

stories.title: The Red Skipping Rope
stories.text:
At the school sports trial, Mina's turn to skip had come. Her legs wobbled. [ha|The red rope with wooden handles] felt heavy in her hands. All around her she could hear [hb|the slap, slap of ropes on the ground], and [hc|her stomach felt tight and fluttery].
===
Last year, Mina's cousin had given her [da|a red rope with wooden handles] for her birthday. Mina had wanted to skip like the big girls.

But the rope had tangled around her feet again and again. [db|The slap, slap of ropes on the ground] had followed every trip. [dc|Her stomach had felt tight and fluttery] with worry. [x1|The other girls had skipped nearby.]

Every afternoon, Mina had practised a little more. [eb|She had counted each jump out loud,] one, two, three. First three jumps, then ten, then twenty. [x2|The wooden handles had grown smooth.]

Mina had learned a secret. [ea|"Little by little, I can do it,"] she had told herself. [ec|Her stomach had felt calm and proud.]
===
Mina took a deep breath. [lb|She counted each jump out loud,] one, two, three. [la|"Little by little, I can do it,"] she whispered. [lc|Her stomach felt calm and proud] as the rope sang round and round.

areas.wl: Mina says the lesson from the end of the flashback again. This shows what Mina has learned.

areas.wr: Good: the slapping sound is part of the Problem, but sounds are less personal than the rope.

stories.title: Lost at the Night Market
stories.text:
At the crowded mall, Raj turned around and could not see his mum. [hb|The smell of sizzling satay] drifted past. [hc|His heart pounded in his chest.] In his pocket was [ha|a yellow balloon on a string].
===
Last year, Raj had gone to the night market with Dad. Dad had bought him [da|a yellow balloon on a string]. [x1|The lights had flashed red and green.]

Raj had let the balloon pull him through the crowd. [db|The smell of sizzling satay] had drifted past. When he looked up, Dad had gone. [dc|His heart had pounded in his chest.]

A helper at the information stall had asked, "Are you lost?" [eb|Raj had walked up to her] and said his name. Dad had come running. [x2|She had worn a green apron.]

Raj had learned a safe rule. [ea|"If I am lost, I stay and ask a helper,"] he had told himself. [ec|His heart had slowed and he had felt safe.]
===
Raj stopped walking. [la|"If I am lost, I stay and ask a helper,"] he told himself. [lb|He walked up to a woman at the information desk] and said his name. [lc|His heart slowed and he felt safe] when Mum hurried over.

stories.title: Snakes and Ladders
stories.text:
Aiden and his cousin were nearly at the end of Snakes and Ladders. Aiden was behind. [hb|The rattle of the dice in the cup] filled the room. [ha|The blue dice with the chipped dot] sat in his palm. [hc|His cheeks burned hot.]
===
Last year, Aiden had been losing to his friend Kai. He had held [da|the blue dice with the chipped dot] and wanted to win badly.

[db|The rattle of the dice in the cup] had stopped, and Aiden had secretly turned the dice to a six. [dc|His cheeks had burned hot.] Kai had seen it and put down his counter. [x1|The game had stopped at the last row.]

Aiden had said, "Sorry, I cheated." [eb|He had moved his counter back] to where it had been. Kai had smiled and they had played on. [x2|The rain had tapped on the window.]

Aiden had learned something. [ea|"A fair win feels better than a fake one,"] he had thought. [ec|He had felt light and honest inside.]
===
Aiden shook the dice and let it fall wherever it landed. [lb|He moved his counter back] when he saw he had gone one step too far. [la|"A fair win feels better than a fake one,"] he thought. [lc|He felt light and honest inside,] even when he lost.

stories.title: The Beach Clean-up
stories.text:
On the school trip to the beach, Shu Ling saw crisp packets and bottles lying in the sand. [hc|Her tummy felt sad and heavy.] [hb|The salty smell of the sea] blew past her. In her bag was [ha|a small green bucket with a crack].
===
Last year, Shu Ling had found [da|a small green bucket with a crack] on the beach with her dad. Someone had left it behind. [x1|A seagull had cried overhead.]

[db|The salty smell of the sea] had turned sour near a heap of rubbish. Plastic bags had tangled in the seaweed and a little crab had been stuck in a bottle. [dc|Her tummy had felt sad and heavy.]

Shu Ling and her dad had filled the bucket again and again. [eb|They had picked up every piece, one by one,] until the sand looked clean. The crab had scuttled free. [x2|The sun had set orange and pink.]

Shu Ling had learned a lesson. [ea|"Small hands can make a big difference,"] she had told her dad. [ec|Her tummy had felt light and happy.]
===
Shu Ling took out the green bucket. [lb|She picked up every piece, one by one,] from the sand. [la|"Small hands can make a big difference,"] she told her friends. [lc|Her tummy felt light and happy] as the beach grew clean.

stories.title: The Blue Toy Box
stories.text:
At school, a box for the toy drive stood by the door. Hafiz carried [ha|a blue toy box with a faded star on the lid], but [hc|his hands gripped tight]. [hb|The little whirr of a toy motor] hummed inside it.
===
Last year, Hafiz had been asked to give a toy to a charity drive. He had opened [da|a blue toy box with a faded star on the lid]. [x1|The box beside it had been full of old books.]

His favourite robot had been inside. [db|The little whirr of a toy motor] had hummed when he pressed the button, and [dc|his hands had gripped tight.] He had not wanted to let it go.

Then he had seen a small boy at the drive with empty hands. [eb|Hafiz had held out the robot with both hands.] The boy's eyes had lit up. [x2|The boy had worn a tiny blue cap.]

Hafiz had learned something. [ea|"Giving feels better than keeping,"] he had told his mum. [ec|His chest had felt warm and bright.]
===
Hafiz took a deep breath and lifted the lid. [lb|He held out a toy with both hands] to the girl at the drive. [la|"Giving feels better than keeping,"] he said quietly. [lc|His chest felt warm and bright.]

stories.title: The Birthday Cake
stories.text:

Priya had stopped and waited. [eb|She had folded her hands in her lap] and sung loudly with everyone else. [x2|Grandpa had blown out the candles.]

stories.title: The Treasure Hunt
stories.text:
Mrs Tan was giving instructions for the class puzzle. [hb|The crackle of the instruction sheet] filled the room. Ethan's mind wandered. [ha|The red pencil with a chewed end] spun in his fingers. [hc|His mind raced and wandered.]
===
Last year, Ethan's class had gone on a treasure hunt. He had twirled [da|a red pencil with a chewed end] while the teacher gave the clues.

[db|The crackle of the instruction sheet] had filled the field. [dc|His mind had raced and wandered.] He had missed the second clue and walked to the wrong end of the field. [x1|The grass had been wet and long.]

His friend Dina had waved him back. [eb|He had stopped, looked at Dina and listened to every word] this time. They had found the box together. [x2|The box had been painted gold.]

Ethan had learned something. [ea|"Listening first saves time later,"] he had told himself. [ec|He had felt calm and focused.]
===
Ethan put down his pencil. [lb|He stopped, looked at Mrs Tan and listened to every word.] [la|"Listening first saves time later,"] he thought. [lc|He felt calm and focused,] and he understood every step.

stories.title: Grandpa's Phone
stories.text:
Grandpa pressed the wrong button on his phone again. Nina sighed. [hb|A beep, beep, beep] came from the phone. [hc|Her patience felt thin.] By the door leaned [ha|a bicycle with a bright green bell].
===
Last year, Grandpa had begun teaching Nina to ride [da|a bicycle with a bright green bell]. [x1|He had worn his old straw hat.]

Nina had wobbled and fallen, again and again. [db|A beep, beep, beep] had come from the bell each time she squeezed it in fright. [dc|Her patience had felt thin,] and she had wanted to quit.

Grandpa had not hurried her. [eb|He had held the back of the seat and walked beside her, step by step.] Soon Nina had pedalled alone. [x2|The path had been lined with frangipani trees.]

Nina had learned something. [ea|"Patience is a way of showing love,"] she had thought. [ec|She had felt warm and thankful.]
===
Nina sat down next to Grandpa. [lb|She held his phone steady and showed him, step by step.] [la|"Patience is a way of showing love,"] she thought. [lc|She felt warm and thankful] as he smiled at the screen.

stories.title: The Night Sky Puzzle
stories.text:
Lucas stared at the puzzle on the table and wanted to quit. In his hand was [ha|a puzzle piece shaped like a star]. [hc|His shoulders sagged.] Nearby, [hb|the click of pieces fitting together] came from Mum's table.
===
Last year, Lucas had begun a hard puzzle of the night sky. He had found [da|a puzzle piece shaped like a star] first.

The puzzle had so many dark pieces. [db|The click of pieces fitting together] had come only now and then. [dc|His shoulders had sagged,] and he had wanted to quit. [x1|The clock had ticked slowly.]

But Lucas had tried one piece at a time. [eb|He had sorted the dark pieces into little piles,] and soon they had clicked into place. [x2|Mum had brought him some milk.]

Lucas had learned something. [ea|"One piece at a time is enough,"] he had told himself. [ec|He had felt tall and proud.]
===

stories.title: The Duck Rattle
stories.text:
Baby Leo was crying and Mum was busy. Sofia stood by the cot. [hb|A soft, gurgling cry] came from the cot. In her hand was [ha|a yellow rattle shaped like a duck]. [hc|Her chest felt squeezed and cross.]
===
Last year, when baby Leo had first come home, Sofia had been given [da|a yellow rattle shaped like a duck] to hold for him.

Everyone had cuddled Leo and nobody had cuddled Sofia. [db|A soft, gurgling cry] had filled the house. [dc|Her chest had felt squeezed and cross,] and she had dropped the rattle on the floor. [x1|The curtains had been drawn.]

Dad had knelt beside her and said, "There is plenty of love for you too." [eb|Sofia had picked up the rattle and shaken it gently] in front of Leo. He had given his first big smile. [x2|Dad had made a cup of tea.]

Sofia had learned something. [ea|"Love grows when we share it,"] she had thought. [ec|Her chest had felt soft and warm.]
===
Sofia took a deep breath. [lb|She picked up the rattle and shook it gently] in front of Leo. [la|"Love grows when we share it,"] she whispered. [lc|Her chest felt soft and warm] as he gave a big gummy smile.
